pedagogy.reason: The steps are concrete and the checkpoints are answerable at a glance, but the recap asks children to bring pebbles from home and one finger instruction cannot be carried out as written.

age_fit.reason: Sentences are short and numbers stay within 999, with Tamil and Hindi number words matching the digits.

accuracy.reason: All sums, digit-to-word pairs and place-value statements checked are correct in both languages.

language_bridge.reason: The recap comparison rule is worded as combining in Hindi but comparing in Tamil, and the comparison conclusion is given only in Hindi.

localisation.reason: Idli, Pongal, Kavin and Meena are used naturally, though the crops, fauna and most district props are otherwise unused.

safety.reason: Each handling of pebbles repeats the do-not-put-in-mouth warning, and there is no shaming, frightening or partisan content.

issues.problem: The Hindi line says 'दो संख्याएँ मिलाओ' (combine two numbers), but the gloss and the Tamil restatement r20 are about comparing, so the Hindi instruction gives the wrong operation.
issues.fix: Replace the Hindi with 'दो संख्याओं की तुलना करो तो पहले सौ वाला अंक देखो।' so it matches the Tamil comparison rule.

issues.problem: The comparison conclusion 'three hundred forty-six is bigger than two hundred fifty' is given only in Hindi, with no school-language restatement.
issues.fix: Add a Tamil line after r21 such as 'முந்நூற்று நாற்பத்தாறு, இருநூற்று ஐம்பதை விடப் பெரியது.'

issues.problem: Children cannot show six fingers on one hand, so 'first three, then four, then six' is not doable as written with only one hand.
issues.fix: Change the instruction to show six as one full hand plus one finger of the other hand, in both the Hindi r10 and the Tamil r11.

issues.problem: The recap asks children to bring ten pebbles from home, but the materials list says the school supplies them and many migrant-family children may have none at home.
issues.fix: Say 'use the ten pebbles from today's class, or ten tamarind seeds' so every child can take part without needing items from home.
